### Repro steps

DevTools manages to handle DOM related highlighting using these two sources

[backend/views/Highlighter](https://github.com/facebook/react/tree/main/packages/react-devtools-shared/src/backend/views/Highlighter): highlights the DOM for the currently selected element
[backend/views/TraceUpdates](https://github.com/facebook/react/tree/main/packages/react-devtools-shared/src/backend/views/TraceUpdates): highlights the DOM when a component renders/updates

we can possibly refactor the same to use a unified canvas based approach, TraceUpdates was already migrated to canvas at some point, but Highlighter still injects DOM nodes.

Shared geometry already exists in `views/utils.js` (getNestedBoundingClientRect, getElementDimensions, mergeRectOffsets, extractHOCNames), used by both views.

The DOM based code  benefit is  it renders the box model (nested translucent margin / border / padding / content bands) easily using CSS borders, along with collision avoidance.  so not sure if its worth refactoring 

though i would love to get my hands dirty if this feels like something helpful 
cc @eps1lon @hoxyq 


### How often does this bug happen?

Every time
